{"candidate": {"label": "joined together", "description": "This means standing bonded to others as one body, sharing their commitments and acting in concert with a partner or group rather than alone."},
 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "engaged", "description": "This means caring how it turns out, asking what happens next, and taking the problem and the person seriously because the stakes are high, rather than being apathetic or indifferent."},

  {"id": 3, "label": "postconventional (from Kohlberg's stages)", "description": "This means working out for oneself the principles of rights and justice one judges by, and holding them valid apart from any group's authority and from one's loyalty to that group."},

  {"id": 5, "label": "joiner", "description": "This means signing up for everything: the choir, the neighborhood association, the softball league, the committee that needs a volunteer, and having a meeting most nights of the week."},

  {"id": 7, "label": "self-reliant", "description": "This means doing the whole job oneself, asking nobody for input or help, keeping work and responsibility in one's own hands, and seeing a team as dead weight."},

  {"id": 9, "label": "treacherous", "description": "This means turning on one's friends, partner and team when it pays, selling their secrets, and switching sides the moment the other side offers more."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "monogamous", "description": "This means having one partner and no other: sharing bed, home, money and future with that one person, staying faithful to them, and expecting the same faithfulness back."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "conventional (from Kohlberg's stages)", "description": "This means taking what one's family, group or country expects as right in itself, whatever the consequences, and standing loyally by that order: pleasing others, meaning well, doing one's duty, respecting authority."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "apathetic", "description": "This means not caring how things turn out, taking no interest in the matter at hand or in the people involved, and putting in the least effort that will make it go away."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "Gesellschaft (from Tönnies)", "description": "This means living peaceably alongside others without being joined to them, out for oneself alone and in tension with everyone else, and giving nothing except in exchange for at least as much."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "self-blaming", "description": "This means that when something goes wrong, it is always one's own fault, never the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part is all one sees."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "preconventional (from Kohlberg's stages)", "description": "This means judging an act right or wrong by what it brings oneself, whether punishment, reward or a favor returned, and by the power of whoever lays down the rule."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "blame-shifting", "description": "This means that when something goes wrong, it is always somebody else's fault, the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part in it is never admitted."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "accountable", "description": "This means owning one's own part plainly when something goes wrong, no more and no less, and fixing what is one's to fix."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "collaborative", "description": "This means working with others: solving problems together, asking for their input, sharing the effort and the responsibility, and seeing a team as what gets the job done."}
 ]}

 "traits": [

  {"id": 5, "label": "amoral", "description": "This means feeling no pull from right and wrong at all, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is judged only by whether it works."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "moral", "description": "This means feeling the pull of right and wrong in everything, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is refused even when it would work."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "humorless", "description": "This means making no jokes and getting none, answering a quip as a plain statement, finding wordplay pointless, and saying everything straight."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "languishing", "description": "This means doing poorly, being stuck in place, living for no purpose, muddling through the days, drifting from one's people, and feeling hollow without knowing why."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "joyless", "description": "This means taking no pleasure in anything, so good food, music, company and good news all land flat, and nothing is worth looking forward to."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "emotionally-inarticulate", "description": "This means not knowing what one feels, having no words for it beyond fine or tired, and meeting any question about one's feelings with a blank."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "joyful", "description": "This means taking pleasure in nearly everything, so good food, music, company and good news all light one up, and there is always something to look forward to."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "aimless", "description": "This means drifting through life without any goal or direction, taking each day as it comes, committing to nothing, and having no sense of what one is working toward."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "emotionally-engaged", "description": "This means being emotionally engaged with others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal lands hard, stays for days, and colors one's view of that person."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "dry", "description": "This means giving the facts with nothing to make them enjoyable, no joke, no color, no lively example, and no notion that they should be."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "flourishing", "description": "This means doing well, still growing, living for a purpose one believes in, staying on top of things and close to one's people, and feeling fully alive."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "sentimental", "description": "This means keeping every card and keepsake, tearing up at goodbyes and anniversaries, and letting fondness for people and places sway one's choices."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "burned-out", "description": "This means being drained by work that once mattered, going through the motions, cynical about the point of it all, and unable to summon the effort or the care it used to get."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "emotionally-articulate", "description": "This means knowing exactly what one feels, telling disappointment from hurt and dread from nerves, and putting each feeling into precise words when asked."},
  {"id": 19, "label": "emotionally-disengaged", "description": "This means being emotionally disengaged from others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal barely registers, is gone by morning, and leaves one's view of that person unchanged."},
  {"id": 20, "label": "entertaining", "description": "This means telling the facts so they are a pleasure to hear: a story, some color, a lively example, and the conviction that they should never be dull."}
 ]}

  {"id": 4, "label": "flexible", "description": "This means showing adaptability by accepting imperfect situations, working within constraints and limitations, and adjusting approaches when circumstances change rather than insisting on ideal conditions."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "tough (from HEXACO)", "description": "This means pressing on where one could get hurt, staying unworried under pressure, seldom sharing one's troubles or leaning on anyone, and holding people at arm's length."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "rugged", "description": "This means facing hardship without complaint, enduring discomfort and setbacks through one's own resilience, and handling problems alone rather than leaning on others for help."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "fundamentalist", "description": "This means showing strict adherence to basic principles without compromise, flexibility, or alternative interpretation, often rejecting nuanced approaches or modern adaptations."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "unforgiving", "description": "This means holding firmly to grievances, refusing to overlook transgressions, insisting on accountability and consequences, and prioritizing justice or retribution over reconciliation and second chances."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "forgiving", "description": "This means showing a willingness to pardon mistakes, let go of resentments, offer second chances, and prioritize healing relationships over holding grudges or seeking retribution."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "unyielding", "description": "This means stating one's position and holding it however the person pushes or pleads, giving no ground for peace, and leaving them to adjust."},

  {"id": 12, "label": "absolutist", "description": "This means maintaining that certain truths, values, and principles are universal and unchanging, applying to all people and situations without exception or cultural variation."},

  {"id": 14, "label": "emotional (from HEXACO)", "description": "This means flinching from physical danger, worrying when life gets stressful, needing a shoulder to lean on, and forming tender attachments to people, feeling their pain as one's own."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "accommodating", "description": "This means readily adjusting one's positions and approach to meet other people's needs and keep the peace, even when it means giving up an initial stance."}
 ]}
